questions.question: What are the names of conductors, sorted descending by the number of years they have worked?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC

questions.question: What are the names of conductors who have conducted at more than one orchestra?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID GROUP BY T2.Conductor_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.Name
FROM conductor AS c
JOIN orchestra AS o ON c.Conductor_ID = o.Conductor_ID
GROUP BY c.Conductor_ID, c.Name
HAVING COUNT(o.Orchestra_ID) > 1;

questions.question: Show the record companies shared by orchestras founded before 2003 and after 2003.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Record_Company FROM orchestra WHERE Year_of_Founded  <  2003 INTERSECT SELECT Record_Company FROM orchestra WHERE Year_of_Founded  >  2003
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT o.Record_Company
FROM orchestra AS o
WHERE o.Record_Company IS NOT NULL
  AND (o.Year_of_Founded < 2003 OR o.Year_of_Founded > 2003)
GROUP BY o.Record_Company
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.Year_of_Founded < 2003 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN o.Year_of_Founded > 2003 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0;

questions.question: Please show the name of the conductor that has conducted orchestras founded after 2008.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID WHERE Year_of_Founded  >  2008
questions.generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.Name FROM conductor AS c JOIN orchestra AS o ON o.Conductor_ID = c.Conductor_ID WHERE o.Year_of_Founded > 2008;

questions.question: Show names for all stadiums except for stadiums having a concert in year 2014.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM stadium EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.year  =  2014
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM concert AS c
    WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
      AND c.Year = '2014'
);

questions.question: What are the names and locations of the stadiums that had concerts that occurred in both 2014 and 2015?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2014 INTERSECT SELECT T2.name ,  T2.location FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id  =  T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.Year  =  2015
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT s.Name, s.Location
FROM stadium AS s
JOIN concert AS c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE c.Year IN ('2014', '2015')
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Location
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.Year) = 2;

questions.question: Which year has most number of concerts?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR FROM concert GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.Year AS year
FROM concert AS c
GROUP BY c.Year
ORDER BY COUNT(c.concert_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: find the package option of the tv channel that do not have any cartoon directed by Ben Jones.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT package_option FROM TV_Channel WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT channel FROM cartoon WHERE directed_by  =  'Ben Jones')

questions.question: Find the series name and country of the tv channel that is playing some cartoons directed by Ben Jones and Michael Chang?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Michael Chang' INTERSECT SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Ben Jones'
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.series_name, c.Country
FROM TV_Channel AS c
JOIN Cartoon AS ca ON ca.Channel = c.id
WHERE ca.Directed_by IN ('Ben Jones', 'Michael Chang')
GROUP BY c.id, c.series_name, c.Country
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Directed_by) = 2;

questions.generated_sql: SELECT Name FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY Level_of_membership DESC;

questions.generated_sql:

questions.question: Find the number of visitors who did not visit any museum opened after 2010.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM visitor WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT t2.visitor_id FROM museum AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t1.open_year  >  2010)

questions.question: What is the name of the visitor who visited both a museum opened before 2009 and a museum opened after 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year  <  2009 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id JOIN museum AS t3 ON t3.Museum_ID  =  t2.Museum_ID WHERE t3.open_year  >  2011
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT v.Name
FROM visitor AS v
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM visit AS vi_before
    JOIN museum AS m_before
        ON vi_before.Museum_ID = m_before.Museum_ID
    WHERE vi_before.visitor_ID = v.ID
      AND m_before.Open_Year < '2009'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM visit AS vi_after
    JOIN museum AS m_after
        ON vi_after.Museum_ID = m_after.Museum_ID
    WHERE vi_after.visitor_ID = v.ID
      AND m_after.Open_Year > '2011'
);

questions.question: Find the name and age of the visitor who bought the most tickets at once.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t1.name ,  t1.age FROM visitor AS t1 JOIN visit AS t2 ON t1.id  =  t2.visitor_id ORDER BY t2.num_of_ticket DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the first names and country codes for players who won both the WTA Championships and the Australian Open?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name  =  'WTA Championships' INTERSECT SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name  =  'Australian Open'
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT p.first_name, p.country_code
FROM matches AS m
JOIN players AS p
    ON p.player_id = m.winner_id
WHERE m.tourney_name IN ('WTA Championships', 'Australian Open')
GROUP BY m.winner_id, p.first_name, p.country_code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.tourney_name) = 2;

questions.question: Which professionals live in the state of Indiana or have done treatment on more than 2 treatments? List his or her id, last name and cell phone.

questions.question: What is the name of each continent and how many car makers are there in each one?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.continent JOIN car_makers AS T3 ON T2.CountryId  =  T3.Country GROUP BY T1.Continent;
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.Continent, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.Id) AS car_maker_count
FROM continents AS c
LEFT JOIN countries AS co ON c.ContId = co.Continent
LEFT JOIN car_makers AS cm ON co.CountryId = cm.Country
GROUP BY c.ContId, c.Continent;

questions.question: What are the ids and makers of all car makers that produce at least 2 models and make more than 3 cars?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Id ,  T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.Id ,  T1.Maker FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T3 ON T2.model  =  T3.model GROUP BY T1.Id HAVING count(*)  >  3;
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker
FROM car_makers AS cm
JOIN model_list AS ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN car_names AS cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model
JOIN cars_data AS cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ml.Model) >= 2
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT cd.Id) > 3;

questions.question: Which of the countries has the most car makers? List the country name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.CountryName FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.Country  =  T2.CountryId GROUP BY T1.Country ORDER BY Count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT countries.CountryName
FROM car_makers
JOIN countries ON car_makers.Country = countries.CountryId
GROUP BY countries.CountryId, countries.CountryName
ORDER BY COUNT(car_makers.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
